tools.name: find_protocol
tools.description: Protein-level protocol aggregates for a protein symbol or alias: how many protocols scienX lists, how many are curated, how many PDB structures, and the best tier. No per-record rows, no DOIs, no method text. Full methods need a free scienX sign-in.

tools.name: find_cro
tools.description: CROs with publicly disclosed or literature-disclosed work for a protein: the provider, and whether the evidence is the provider’s own public claim or a literature disclosure. No DOIs, no sentences. Full evidence is on the public finder page.

tools.name: find_supplier
tools.description: Off-the-shelf products listed on scienX’s off-the-shelf page for a protein: supplier, catalog number, product name, species, expression host, size and price. Only products the page actually lists; a protein with no listed products returns an empty list. Stock items, not made-to-order.
